title: Lentil and swede shepherd's pie
summary: Lentil and swede shepherd's pie is a british dinner built around canned green lentils and swede, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Lentil and swede shepherd's pie into even pieces and toss swede with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of swede while you season canned green lentils. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle canned green lentils and carrots among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Lentil and swede shepherd's pie before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Lentil and swede shepherd's pie into warm bowls with the juices.
